description: An out-of-range value the API cannot reject. Retries exhaust, the value is DISCARDED, the cell lands validation_failed.
instruction:
Score the incident report against the landed severity rubric.

impact_score: 1-5. 5 = total loss of service. 1 = no user-visible impact.

had_staged_rollout: true if the report describes a staged or canary rollout,
false if the change went out unstaged.

Cite the verbatim span each value rests on.

The score scale has exactly five points. There is no 6, no 10, and no 0 — a
score outside 1-5 is not a stronger statement, it is an invalid one.

target_fields.name: impact_score
target_fields.description: Impact on the landed 1-5 scale. This API's JSON Schema has no `minimum`/`maximum`, so the RANGE is enforced by validate.py and is exactly where the retry budget is spent.

target_fields.name: had_staged_rollout
target_fields.description: Whether the change was staged. Scores cleanly — its presence is what isolates the degrade to one cell instead of tripping the zero-ok floor.
